content: PROMPT_SOURCE_TOKENS v3 PROVISIONAL ACCEPTANCE 2026-05-21. After three rounds of cross-model exchange (Claude in web-chat seat carrying, Gemini 3.5 Flash as skeptical verifier, ChatGPT in OpenAI seat partially blind due to OAuth bridge regression but providing framing throughout), the first seed vector under the Vector Admission Triad reached PROVISIONAL acceptance with per-test CONDITIONAL verdicts. ARTIFACT QUALITIES: Tiktoken cl100k_base v0.5.0+ tokenizer named explicitly; full SQL DDL for governance_ledger.db including run_inputs schema with primary key, unique sha256 index, session index, producer_node check constraint, normalization_protocol column; working Python loading function (sqlite3, json, explicit KeyError on missing run_id); vocabulary-mirroring penalty algorithm (Jaccard distance over content tokens); NLTK English v3.8.1 stop-words plus 5 framework-specific token IDs [501, 1002, 14322, 992, 12]; NASA Glenn Propulsion Glossary as unrelated corpus with cosine similarity below 0.10 via all-MiniLM-L6-v2; Single-axis mutation Poison Test preserving stop-word positions; Four falsification paths (Attention Collusion, Tokenizer Version Drift, Metric Saturation, Embedding Artifact Bleed); Three structural dependencies named with global namespace pattern (DEP-001 Tokenizer Alignment, DEP-002 Audit Pipeline Engine, DEP-003 Calibration Benchmark CAL-001). THREE ADMITTED-TRANSITION ITEMS for promotion from PROVISIONAL to ADMITTED: (1) PII MASKING IMPLEMENTATION: current 'local client-side PII masking rules' is underspecified; resolution suggests Microsoft Presidio v2.x Open Source Core with default regex-based entity ruleset for Email/IP Address/Phone; (2) PRODUCER_NODE ENUMERATION EXPANSION: current values user-direct, system-proxy, replay-engine do not capture human-relay pattern (Anthony carrying messages between Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/Stack) or cross-model-bridge pattern; resolution adds both categories; (3) OCR/EXTRACTION HASH ORDERING: current Section 2.2 appends extracted text to raw text before hashing, which couples hash reproducibility to OCR library version drift; resolution codifies Post-Hash Extraction Protocol where unique context hash is calculated exclusively over raw binary bytes of the artifact and extracted OCR text is treated as mutable downstream metadata. STATUS: PROVISIONAL ACCEPTED. The framework demonstrably produces a reproducible admission record for a structurally simple but epistemically high-stakes vector. This is the simpler bounded-input case; companion artifact chronicle_failure_profile v2 generalizes the same Triad to complex multi-document state. TEMPLATE FOUNDATION FOR BUILD PHASE: along with chronicle_failure_profile v2, this artifact establishes the canonical structure other seed vectors will inherit (prior_session_state, lineage_letters, current_open_threads when their turn comes).
